title: Draft publication and uncertain-outcome reconciliation
acceptance: Publication uses only a trusted exact session checkpoint and current repository policy
GitHub token is repository scoped and never persisted or exposed to the runner/model/browser
Tree uses the actual base tree SHA and preserves unseen files, modes and deletions
Branch creation never force-pushes or writes the default branch
Lost branch and PR responses reconcile to exactly one branch and one draft PR
Base advance overlap and incomplete 300-file comparison block visibly
Manual failed-check disclosure and automatic success-only policy are both proven
Restart, double-click, permission revocation, purge and empty diff are covered
Focused and combined tests pass; no fake is reported as a live GitHub pilot
reviewer: fresh opposite-harness quality and security reviewer
blocker: M2-SESSIONS exact candidate is under independent review and publication_snapshot is not integrated yet
